rationale: Calculated fault currents using Thevenin equivalent impedances for source, transformer, and feeder. Max 3-phase fault at near bus (0.2 km) is 9.299 kA. Min 2-phase fault at remote end (8 km) is 1.742 kA. Breaker rating 12.5 kA selected as smallest standard rating above 9.299*1.1=10.229 kA. Relay pickup 500 A satisfies load margin (360*1.25=450 A) and sensitivity (1742/2=871 A) constraints.
